# Support tickets

## Creation
In order to open a support ticket, create a New Issue using one of the available templates.
Once created, the support team will be notified and respond as soon as it is possible.

## Management
The issue will stay open until it is solved or it has expired; the support team will manage the issue by comment or release.

Inactive issues with no pending actions will be closed after a certain period of time.

## Closing
Tickets can be closed directly by the issuer, or by the support technician after confirmation that the issue has been solved.

# Shared files
Files will be shared through the **Release** section of the repository. The naming of releases follows the standard:
Name: **Product - Version**

Example: firmware for 1xVeronte 6.8.X will be shared as follows:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/106614525/236782271-0617d823-7443-410c-9975-4987012cd8ca.png)

Relevant files can be downloaded from the **Assets** dropdown.
